title: The college closed
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The college closes for the storm. Nobody told the auditor. Wood sits in Lot C alone with the box of everything. He opens the box. The strip cuts before he takes anything out.

panels.composition: Lot C, empty, rain, the building dark. A sign on the door drawn as blocks. The Datsun the only car.

image.prompt: an empty rain-swept community college parking lot with a dark building and a single small car, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD in the car. Looking back at the box on the back seat. Taped.

image.prompt: a young man in a car's driver's seat looking over his shoulder at a taped cardboard box on the back seat, black and white, no words

panels.composition: His hand on the tape. Pulling. The box open an inch. Pages inside, a rubber band.

image.prompt: close on a young man's hand pulling tape from a cardboard box's lid, pages visible inside under a rubber band, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The car from outside in the rain. The dome light on. Whatever he's reading, the strip is not in there with him.

image.prompt: a small car alone in a rainy parking lot at dusk with its dome light on, a figure inside bent over something, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The box, opened an inch. The strip stays outside.
